about.title: About Us
about.description_1: At BuildX, we hold firm to our core values: optimal, aesthetic design, technically precise construction, and quality assurance for every real-world project.
about.description_2: But amid the construction industry's strong digital transformation, BuildX believes the true value of every project lies not only in steel and concrete, but originates from precise, intelligent, data-rich digital models. All project information is fully integrated into the 3D model, letting you access, manage, and leverage information anytime, anywhere on an online platform, eliminating dependence on traditional paper records.

bim.title: BIM Solutions
bim.subtitle: Smart design & construction management solutions with BIM technology at BuildX
bim.description: You don't just own a physical building — you also hold a complete "digital twin". This is a fully integrated data system covering architecture, structure, and MEP, making it easy, accurate, and cost-effective to manage and retrieve the project's data in the future.

design.title: Design & Consulting
design.description: At BuildX, every design solution is not just aesthetic creativity but the optimal answer to technical and functional challenges. We provide consulting based on real-world data and intuitive 3D simulation, helping you bring your dream living space to life with absolute precision from the very first idea.

construction.title: Construction
construction.description: Professional construction teams ensuring project timelines and quality according to technical standards.
